description: MAME (0.244) per-game cfg rewriting. Base file = live cfg\<game>.cfg, else the previous owner's reference set (targets: mame[].reference) - MAME needs the exact port tag/type/mask/defvalue, so games without a base file are skipped. For each port: (1) 'games.<game>.ports' or the global 'ports' (by port type) gives a logical control -> the whole standard sequence is replaced; (2) otherwise every JOYCODE token is translated through 'referenceLayout' (what that token meant on the owner's G29) to the captured device; tokens with no known meaning stay on the same physical button but move to the profile's device number. A ctrlr file (ctrlr\wheelmap.cfg) pins JOYCODE_1.. to the profile devices with <mapdevice>, and mame.ini 'ctrlr' is set to it, so enumeration order no longer matters.

referenceLayout.note: Owner's G29 sets: START1=BUTTON11, COIN1=BUTTON12, gears BUTTON13-16, paddles BUTTON5/6, wheel X, gas Y, brake RZ, clutch SLIDER1. 'COMMANDEDEPOUCE*' are French-locale DirectInput hat names (the files were made on a French Windows) - they do not resolve on an English install and are translated to HAT1*.

outrun.title: Out Run
outrun.notes: Lo/Hi gear lever is a toggle (P1_BUTTON3) - right paddle.

acedrive.title: Ace Driver
acedrive.notes: Sequential lever: up = downshift (left paddle), down = upshift (right paddle), as the owner's working file.

ridgerac.title: Ridge Racer
ridgerac.notes: 4-way gear lever on P1_JOYSTICK_* (owner used face buttons), clutch pedal used as a switch (SLIDER1_NEG_SWITCH). FFB: none in MAME.

calspeed.title: California Speed
calspeed.notes: 4-speed H; P1_BUTTON7-10 view/music buttons stay on the same wheel buttons.

crusnusa.title: Cruis'n USA
crusnusa.notes: 4-speed H; view buttons 1-4 stay on face buttons.

vr.title: Virtua Racing
vr.notes: VR1-4 view buttons + shift up/down on P1_BUTTON7/8 (owner: paddles).

sf2049.title: San Francisco Rush 2049
sf2049.notes: Clutch pedal P1_PEDAL3. START1 used a French hat name in the owner's file.

polepos2a.title: Pole Position II
polepos2a.notes: Owner's file swaps ACCEL/BRAKE tags (ACCEL=RZ, BRAKE=Y) - the port-type rule puts P1_PEDAL on Gas; check in-game.
